children: BuzzFeed entered into a Share Purchase Agreement with Allen Family Digital to sell 1,700,000 newly issued Class A shares at $1.06 per share, generating approximately $1.8 million. The purchase, dated September 11, 2026, was approved by the audit committee and disinterested directors; Chairman Byron Allen Folks disclosed his interest and abstained. The unregistered issuance relies on Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and is intended to bolster liquidity.
